name: chaya-b3-phrasing-v1
provenance: DERIVED MECHANICALLY on 2026-10-14 from dataset.json (unchanged) before any search result was computed with it. No new query or expected answer was written: every derived query keeps its source query's `expected` list. Templates wrap the B3 query in the sentence forms users type or say ('Where is the reception?', 'Find the nearest staircase'). The misspelling rule deletes one character mechanically. Regression/sanity only, like the rest of B3.

misspelling.rule: for each query of the listed types: take its longest word (the first on a tie); if it has at least 5 letters, delete the character at index len(word) // 2; queries without such a word are skipped
